data.long_description:
Discover contemporary living in Golfville, a vibrant and lifestyle-focused community in Dubai Hills Estate.

This well-designed 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment spans 744.62 sqft and offers a smart, functional layout ideal for modern living. The open-plan living and dining area is complemented by large windows, allowing natural light to fill the space and create a bright, airy atmosphere.

Both bedrooms are efficiently laid out with built-in wardrobes, maximizing storage while maintaining a clean and modern aesthetic. The bathroom is finished with high-quality fittings, ensuring both comfort and practicality.

Residents of Golfville enjoy access to a wide range of premium amenities, including a fully equipped gym, swimming pool, co-working spaces, and social lounges designed to foster a strong sense of community. With its proximity to parks, retail outlets, and key road networks, this property offers both convenience and a dynamic lifestyle.

Ideal for end-users and investors alike, this apartment presents an excellent opportunity to live in one of Dubai’s most sought-after communities.
